name: Tabletop Gallery
summary:
**Tabletop Gallery** transforms your room into an **interactive mixed-reality sharing platform** for immersive media. Built exclusively for XR, it brings photos and videos to life right on your virtual table.

- 🖼️ **Supports all major media types:** 2D, 3D Side-by-Side, MPO 3D photos, VR180, VR360 images and videos.

- 🌌 **Holo Viewer:** Experience images with depth that respond to your head movement — creating a holographic-like effect.
